description: This Java class defines a custom Spring Condition for validating configuration properties related to partitioned jobs in Fineract. It checks if partition sizes, chunk sizes, thread pool sizes, and queue capacities are properly configured and logs errors if invalid configurations are found.

classes.name: FineractPartitionJobConfigValidationCondition
classes.description: A Spring Condition class that validates partitioned job configuration properties for correctness.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the partitioned job properties are invalid based on specific criteria and logs errors for each invalid configuration.

methods.name: isAnyConfigBelowOne
methods.description: Returns a predicate that checks if any of the partitioned job parameters are less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: invalidMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Checks if the maximum pool size is less than the core pool size, indicating an invalid configuration.
